description: This source file contains utility functions for testing, including creating temporary directories, removing directories, writing files, and handling errors within tests.

methods.name: TempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for testing, returning its path. Generates unique directory names and terminates the test if creation fails.

methods.name: RemoveDir
methods.description: Removes the specified directory, terminating the test on failure.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file with specified permissions, returning an error if unsuccessful.

methods.name: FatalIfNil
methods.description: Checks if an error is nil, and if not, terminates the test with a fatal error.
